# site/tests/fixtures

Data the tests read.

- `gen-vectors.sh` — regenerates vectors.json with openssl
- `github-releases.json` — an answer of the GitHub Releases API
- `release.json` — the sample release used by local and CI builds
- `SHA256SUMS` — a release's checksum file
- `user-agents.json` — user agents with the detection each must give
- `vectors.json` — throwaway certificates and signatures over the test page's sample text
